summary: Valneva SE filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing senior management's participation in upcoming U.S. and European investor conferences in June 2026. No transaction, merger, acquisition, tender offer, or similar special-situation event is described. The press release outlines conference appearances, including a fireside chat and investor meetings at the Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference, Oddo BHF Nextcap Forum, and BNP Paribas SMID Cap Conference, as well as a medical conference. This is a routine investor relations announcement with no deal terms or corporate event implications.
